epics.title: Development workflow and project memory
epics.body: Make Plantarium's development state recoverable across Claude Code sessions and visible to the maintainer: a local Kanban board for development tasks, persistent project memory in docs/, and lightweight session hooks.

epics.title: Roadmap
epics.body: Next directions from the README roadmap that have a concrete first step. Other roadmap items stay in the README until they are planned.

tickets.title: Review one species' care and size data against cited sources
tickets.body:
All plant values are `dataQuality: 'placeholder'` and `src/data/sources.ts` is empty. Pilot the review workflow on one species so it can be repeated.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] One species chosen with the maintainer
- [ ] Real sources added to `sources.ts` and referenced via `sourceRefs`
- [ ] Values corrected where sources disagree; entry set to `reviewed` only if every subject is covered
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING source-reference guidance updated with lessons learned
- [ ] Unit and browser tests pass

tickets.title: Test the GLB model path end to end with a real asset
tickets.body:
GLB loading and failure recovery are only tested with synthetic GLTF files; no real horticultural asset has been reviewed.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] A licence-compatible real GLB (shoot, optionally roots) that follows the README contract
- [ ] Browser test covering load, region materials and fallback
- [ ] Decide whether root-view effects or hotspot snapping should support GLB (decision record if yes)
- [ ] README GLB status updated

tickets.title: Adaptive rendering quality for lower-end devices
tickets.body:
The stage renders at one quality level. Lower-end and mobile GPUs may struggle.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Measure frame time on a throttled or low-end profile to confirm there is a problem
- [ ] Pick a mechanism (pixel ratio cap, shadow/geometry detail levels) with a decision record
- [ ] No visual change on capable devices; production smoke tests still pass

tickets.title: Set up Kanban board, project memory and session context hook
tickets.body:
Replace the PR-centric GitHub Project #7 workflow with a local claude-kanban board for development tasks, and give every Claude Code session a reliable way to recover project state.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] claude-kanban v3.8.2 installed pinned, binary verified via build-provenance attestation; auto-merge and auto-review stay off
- [ ] `.kanban/board.json` and `.kanban/config.json` committed; runtime files ignored
- [ ] `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/DECISIONS/` exist and match the repository
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` imports `AGENTS.md` and defines the session-start protocol and ticket workflow
- [ ] SessionStart hook prints branch, git and board state in under a second and never fails the session
- [ ] GitHub Project #7 repurposed for maintenance and external contributions (nothing deleted)
- [ ] lint, build, unit and browser tests pass
- [ ] A fresh `claude -p` session reports the current state and the correct next task
- [ ] Changes delivered in PR #32, left open for review
